 import unittest

+from textutil import count_lines, char_frequency
 
 
 class CountLinesTest(unittest.TestCase):
@@ -11,5 +11,40 @@ class CountLinesTest(unittest.TestCase):
         self.assertEqual(count_lines(""), 0)
 
 
+class CharFrequencyTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_empty_input(self):
+        self.assertEqual(char_frequency(""), {})
+
+    def test_single_character(self):
+        self.assertEqual(char_frequency("a"), {"a": 1})
+
+    def test_repeated_characters(self):
+        self.assertEqual(char_frequency("aaa"), {"a": 3})
+
+    def test_mixed_characters(self):
+        self.assertEqual(char_frequency("aab"), {"a": 2, "b": 1})
+
+    def test_case_sensitive(self):
+        self.assertEqual(char_frequency("Aa"), {"A": 1, "a": 1})
+
+    def test_whitespace_characters(self):
+        result = char_frequency("a b\tc\nd")
+        self.assertEqual(result["a"], 1)
+        self.assertEqual(result[" "], 1)
+        self.assertEqual(result["\t"], 1)
+        self.assertEqual(result["\n"], 1)
+        self.assertEqual(result["d"], 1)
+
+    def test_unicode_characters(self):
+        result = char_frequency("café")
+        self.assertEqual(result["c"], 1)
+        self.assertEqual(result["a"], 1)
+        self.assertEqual(result["f"], 1)
+        self.assertEqual(result["é"], 1)
+
+    def test_unicode_repeated(self):
+        self.assertEqual(char_frequency("αα"), {"α": 2})
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()

+
+
+def char_frequency(s):
+    """Return a dict mapping every character to its occurrence count."""
+    freq = {}
+    for char in s:
+        freq[char] = freq.get(char, 0) + 1
+    return freq
